# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 12 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB BTO & Resale Market

- **November BTO draws over 35,600 applications — two-room flats hit record demand** - The November 2026 BTO exercise attracted over 35,600 applications, the highest application rate since 2022, with two-room flats recording a record number of applicants. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/november-bto-draws-35600-applications-two/)

- **November 2026 BTO: 7,964 flats across seven projects, first launch under higher income ceilings** - HDB launched flats in Bedok, Geylang, Sembawang, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun; by midday on 10 November, 31,776 applications had been received, working out to about four applications per flat. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-application-rates/)

- **February 2027 BTO preview: around 4,300 flats in Bishan, Tampines, Tengah and Toa Payoh** - The next BTO exercise will offer roughly 4,300 flats across five projects, and HDB will also run a Sale of Balance Flats exercise with about 5,000 flats, bringing combined supply to around 9,300 homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/february-2027-bto-launch-preview/)

- **Yishun records its first HDB resale above S$1.3M** - A 1,765 sqft executive apartment at Block 652 Yishun Avenue 4 sold for S$1,328,888 in November 2026, becoming Yishun's most expensive HDB resale across all flat types. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/yishun-hdb-resale-record-nee-soon-central-view/)

## Private Residential Market

- **Lentor area now has 3,400 new homes; early Lentor Modern buyers averaged $314K in gains** - A review of all seven new Lentor condos covers land prices, sales volumes, sub-sale gains and rents across the cluster since it was developed. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/lentor-moderns-early-buyers-made-312k-on-average-how-all-7-new-lentor-condos-have-done-so-far-2/)

- **Two adjoining freehold GCBs near Botanic Gardens offered at $53M via EOI** - The two properties at 15 and 15A Camden Park in District 11 are priced at $26M and $27M respectively, and are available for purchase separately or together. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-side-side-bungalow-plots-near/)

## Commercial & Landmark Deals

- **Foreign groups in deals worth up to $11B for Singapore's marquee buildings** - Hongkong Land and IOI are acquiring landmark Singapore buildings in transactions that could total approximately $11 billion. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-marquee-assets-having-moment-year/)
